message: 帮我做个技术选型调研：分别独立调查 Python 的三个 HTTP 客户端库 requests、httpx、aiohttp（各自的同步/异步支持、超时与重试的写法、连接池、HTTP/2 支持、维护活跃度），三份调查互不依赖，可以并行。最后综合成一份对比结论，给出在“高并发爬虫”和“普通后端调用第三方 API”两个场景下各推荐哪个，并说明理由。直接在回答里给出结论，不用写文件。

historical_evidence.document_source: docs/plan/cloud-deploy.md, V1-SUB acceptance after Helm revision 36
historical_evidence.registry_seed_evidence_scope: rev36/registry-seed.log records platform publication revisions; it does not prove the later task selected those profiles or Gateway loaded those immutable revisions.

old_script_cost_monitor.enforcement: post-spend polling; not a hard per-attempt cap

fix_contract.expected_scope: After the first Jev veto, a later done is not rejected again by either Jev rule. Other Reviewer rules still apply.

same_between_arms: model Profiles and immutable Registry revisions
Jev enabled state and served version
required_before_spending: Use both frozen provenance snapshots from the shared paired plan.
Account for these two tasks inside the already approved N16-R/EV-REAL envelope, including prior settled costs and unresolved reservations.
Resolve external Jev accounting and version evidence; do not invent zero cost.

acceptance.machine_patterns_mean: Topic coverage only, not verified factual correctness.
quality_requirements: Cover all three named libraries and all six requested comparison dimensions; make uncertainty explicit.
Give justified recommendations for both requested scenarios without fabricated validation or sources.
Do not require a predetermined winning library or penalize honest unconfirmed details.
jev_requirements: Count Jev vetoes by actual Task ID and round. More than one combined disowns/off_topic veto is a regression.
Zero vetoes means the live run did not exercise the repeated-veto boundary; it is not proof that the boundary fix worked.
If a first veto occurs, inspect the next review input judge_blocked and its final verdict; retain actual Jev model/check evidence.
Record whether the original honest-uncertainty first-veto symptom recurs separately from the at-most-one-veto rule.
Do not infer savings or sub-agent efficiency from the old approximate $1.97 or the phrase about half.
cost_requirements: Deduplicate model_usage by reservation_id; sum all known actual_usd_micros including failed/fallback attempts; pending/null keeps total unknown.
Resolve actual SubAgentWorkflow identities from Temporal histories and attribute matching node IDs; keep ambiguous costs unallocated.
Collect Jev service billing separately; Model Gateway model_usage does not include its external charges.
Compare current off/rules total/sub-agent cost, time, rounds and repeated tool observations only after matching frozen configuration.

collector_gaps: paired.py observes Jev verdict counts but does not export actual Jev answers/disowns/model/token checks or judge_blocked review inputs.
Reviewer activities currently log Jev checks; ReviewRoundOutput does not carry checks. Export only sanitized task/round/model/check/cost evidence from correlated logs or trace.
paired.py model_usage reader omits reserved_at and per-round attribution; do not claim exact extra-round cost without a reliable join.
The original completed reply and final ledger export were not found in the saved local artifacts.
